sections.Profile:
"Jalisco," released in 1976, is a single-player, electromechanical pinball machine from the Recreativos Franco family, catalogued under its export brand Interflip.

- Manufacturer: Interflip S. A.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Dancing, Original Theme, Mexico, 1970s, Solid State
